docs.title: Commands
docs.text:
• mkdocs new [dir-name] - Create a new project.
  • mkdocs serve - Start the live-reloading docs server.
  • mkdocs build - Build the documentation site.
  • mkdocs -h - Print help message and exit.

docs.title: Project Overview
docs.text: This project demonstrates my understanding of Markdown language and its syntax. I have learned how to structure documents using headings, lists, code blocks, links, images, and other Markdown features.

docs.title: Key Concepts Learned
docs.text:
• Headings: Organize content using #, ##, ###, etc.
  • Lists: Create ordered and unordered lists.
  • Code Blocks: Display code snippets using backticks or triple backticks.
  • Links: Add hyperlinks to external resources.
  • Images: Embed images using Markdown syntax.
  • Emphasis: Use italic and bold text for emphasis.

docs.title: Example Markdown Syntax
docs.text:
# Heading 1
## Heading 2

- Unordered list item
1. Ordered list item

**Bold text**
*Italic text*

[Link to Markdown Guide](https://www.markdownguide.org)

docs.title: Outcome
docs.text: By completing this project, I am now able to write clear and well-structured documentation using Markdown.
